About Shape Packing Auto-Researcher

Background, purpose, internal use guidelines, and citation information.

Project Purpose

The Shape Packing Auto-Researcher project automates the exploration, verification, and benchmark tracking of 2D polygon packing problems. It is designed to act as an internal workbench for algorithmic development, log analysis, and continuous performance evaluation against Erich Friedman's historical packing benchmarks.

Internal Use & Citation Notice

This GitHub Pages site serves as an operational dashboard for ongoing algorithm experiments and research tasks. Results displayed on this dashboard reflect automated solver runs and references. They are intended for internal system debugging, performance tuning, and geometric visualization, and should not be cited as definitive mathematical proofs without explicit secondary verification.

How to Use This Site

  • Results Dashboard: Use search and family dropdown filters to locate specific configuration bounds (N, shape tokens).
  • Per-Family Pages: Access detailed requirement specifications and family-level packing metrics via /family/<slug>.
  • Visualizations: Check solutions with vector SVG drawings rendered directly from position coordinate matrices.
